releases.releaseNotes:
This update significantly expands CarryAwareNJ’s map, alert, and community-reporting capabilities:

* Expanded and corrected restricted-location data, including alcohol-related establishments
* Faster viewport-based loading as you move around the map
* Improved marker, clustering, and map stability
* More customizable alert categories, distances, quiet zones, and statute links
* Improved community reporting with nearby-place and street-address selection
* Establishment photos can now be added while creating a report or afterward
* Community voting, photo moderation, content reporting, and contributor blocking
* Categorized remote updates and improved notification handling
* Account deletion, privacy, and reliability improvements

Thank you for helping improve CarryAwareNJ.

Community reporting is now easier and more useful:

• A simpler report form with improved address and nearby business suggestions
• Establishment photos for new and existing community reports
• Photo galleries and moderation tools to help keep submissions useful
• Improved voting, content reporting, and contributor controls
• In-app account deletion with community-data cleanup
• Additional interface and reliability improvements
